review.intent_summary: Callers can change action and notification eligibility on existing evidence without rerunning numerical analysis or mutating the original result.

criteria.criterion: Default policy leaves action and notification eligibility disabled.
Explicit-rule and calibrated-departure eligibility are controlled independently.
Notification eligibility can be allowed for a met criterion without action eligibility, while early candidates remain ineligible.
Replaying policy preserves numerical evidence and stable case IDs, records changed case revisions, and leaves the original result unchanged.

verification_evidence: Executed examples/agentic/unit-cost.json with default policy and replayed allow_explicit_rules: observed unit cost remained 0.15714285714285714 against maximum 0.13; both eligibility flags changed from false to true. Assertions confirmed unchanged numerical evidence and original result, stable case IDs, and changed revision IDs.
